proposed_widenings.name: DurationKindUpcastTier
proposed_widenings.justification: Upcast at slot 4+ changes the duration KIND (concentration → permanent/until-dispelled) rather than just the amount. DurationUpcastTier only allows changing the numeric amount within the same duration kind. A new upcast variant is needed to express 'at slot N, switch to a different Duration family entirely.'
proposed_widenings.evidence: Using a Higher-Level Spell Slot (4+): The spell lasts until dispelled, without requiring Concentration.

notes: Core mechanics (create_illusion + reposition_attachment + on_creature_studies/ability_check_gate) all encoded cleanly after Apr 18 widening. Typecheck and tracer both pass. The only gap is the slot-4+ upcast that promotes the spell from concentration to permanent — a duration-kind upgrade with no surface representation. The onPass=none for the disbelief check is honest: 'creature can see through the image' is perception state / DM-agenda output, not a mechanical EffectAtom.
